quote: we choose several natural language models and benchmarks, including ... Transformer on neural machine translation.
We adopt the Transformer model ... with BLEU score evaluation metric.
We adopt the Transformer model based on the Fairseq implementation on IWSLT 15 English-Vietnamese (En-Vi) and IWSLT 14 German-English (De-En) datasets with the BLEU score evaluation metric.
outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in machine translation (e.g., En-Vi, De-En), language modeling (PTB-LM), and text classification (IMDB).

quote: on IWSLT 15 English-Vietnamese (En-Vi) and IWSLT 14 German-English (De-En) datasets with the BLEU score evaluation metric.

On the text classification task, we adopt Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) on the IMDb movie reviews dataset (IMDB) with the accuracy (ACC) evaluation metric. On the language modeling task, we adopt Long Short-term Memory (LSTM) networks on the English Penn TreeBank (PTB-LM) dataset with the perplexity (PPL) evaluation metric. On the neural machine translation task, we adopt the Transformer model based on the Fairseq implementation on IWSLT 15 English-Vietnamese (En-Vi) and IWSLT 14 German-English (De-En) datasets with the BLEU score evaluation metric.
